articles.summary: AI adoption has created significant copyright compliance gaps, with researchers often unaware of their organization's policies. Emerging infrastructure and direct publisher partnerships are beginning to bridge the divide between AI capabilities and copyright permissions.
articles.title: Your AI Tools Might Be Breaking Copyright Law. Here's How To Stay Compliant.

articles.summary: How mounting fraud, irreproducibility, and AI-generated content are undermining research, and what forward-thinking organizations are doing about it.
articles.title: The 89% Problem: When Published Research Can't Be Trusted
